skill.name: egov-laws
skill.description: Retrieve Japanese statutes through the official e-Gov Law API v2. Search titles, read numbered articles, check historical text, list revisions, and search keywords.
skill.summary: Look up Japanese statute text and revision metadata without an API key.
skill.author: tahodev

No evidence found of prompt injection, credential access, data exfiltration, system reconnaissance, or executable obfuscation. The helper sends user-provided search terms to the official API and prints retrieved statute data.

content.value_statement: Japanese statute research requires accurate article numbers and revision dates. This skill retrieves official e-Gov text and metadata without an API key.
actual_capabilities: Search statute titles and return law identifiers, law numbers, enforcement dates, and revision statuses.
Resolve exact law titles or accept statute identifiers, stopping with candidates when a name is ambiguous.
Retrieve main-provision articles by actual article number, including branch numbers such as 3-2.
Request article text for a specified date on or after 2017-04-01.
List revision metadata, including amendments that are not yet enforced.
Search statute text by keyword and return up to two shortened sentence excerpts per result.
limitations: Provides statute text, not legal interpretation, case law, or personalized legal advice.
Historical lookup cannot retrieve dates before 2017-04-01.
The article helper searches main provisions only and excludes supplementary provisions.
Requires Python 3 and network access; API maintenance can interrupt queries, and results do not include automatic translation.

use_cases.title: Retrieve a cited article
use_cases.description: Find a Japanese statute article by its actual number and retain the law identifier and revision metadata for citation.

use_cases.title: Review amendment schedules
use_cases.description: List enforcement dates and revision statuses to distinguish enforced amendments from pending revisions.

use_cases.title: Locate statutory references
use_cases.description: Search statute text for a topic keyword and identify relevant laws before preparing a source-based article.

prompt_templates.title: Find a statute
prompt_templates.prompt: Search e-Gov for the Japanese Civil Code using its official Japanese title. Show matching titles, law identifiers, and enforcement dates.

prompt_templates.title: Read a numbered article
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve Civil Code Article 709 by article number. Show its original Japanese text, law identifier, revision identifier, and enforcement date.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: retrieve a precise statutory citation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare historical text
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve Civil Code Article 4 for 2017-04-01 and today. Present both original texts and revision metadata without legal interpretation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare two supported dates using separate lookups.

prompt_templates.title: Research revisions and keywords
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Japanese statutes for a keyword I provide. For a selected law, list recent revisions and distinguish pending amendments from enforced revisions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine keyword discovery with revision review.

best_practices: Use an official Japanese title or law identifier, and confirm ambiguous search candidates before retrieving text.
Record the requested date, revision identifier, and enforcement date with each article citation.
Use article numbers rather than element positions, and keep search terms free of confidential case details.
anti_patterns: Treating retrieved statute text as personalized legal advice or a substitute for professional interpretation.
Assuming an API element position equals an article number, especially across revisions.
Treating every listed amendment as enforced or excluding laws solely because their status is PreviousEnforced.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: No. The official e-Gov Law API requires neither authentication nor registration, and the helper uses the Python standard library.

faq.question: Which historical dates are supported?
faq.answer: Use dates on or after 2017-04-01. Earlier dates are outside the documented API support.

faq.question: Can I retrieve branch articles?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper accepts forms such as 3-2, 3_2, and 3の2, then matches the actual article number.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves statute text and metadata, not legal interpretation, court decisions, or advice about individual cases.

faq.question: Can revision history include future amendments?
faq.answer: Yes. Revision results include enforcement dates and statuses, allowing you to distinguish pending amendments from enforced revisions.

faq.question: What happens during API maintenance?
faq.answer: The API may return HTML instead of JSON. The helper reports a non-JSON response; retry later rather than treating it as statute text.
